name: 阿里云盘
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=阿里云盘
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = api.alipan.com, member.alipan.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.alipan\.com\/adrive\/v1\/file\/getTopFolders/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/member\.alipan\.com\/v2\/activity\/sign_in_luckyBottle/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.alipan\.com\/apps\/v2\/users\/home\/(news|widgets)/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/adrive/adrive.js") with enable=${alyp_enable}, tag="阿里云盘", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/member\.alipan\.com\/v1\/users\/onboard_list/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/adrive/adrive.js") with enable=${alyp_enable}, tag="阿里云盘", timeout=60, requires_body=true
